title: El Caballo de Parral, MEXITV
comment: lucero-parral (MEXITV): corrales de la feria ganadera de Parral, Chihuahua. Caras comunes, no famosas; los tres se distinguen a simple vista.

chars.RUFINO_ALCANTARA: Mexican cattle rancher from Chihuahua, 62 years old, deeply tanned skin, short grey hair, a thick white mustache, a beige straw cowboy hat, a light-blue denim western shirt, a brown leather vest, jeans, brown cowboy boots, his hands empty.
chars.ISMAEL_QUINONES: Mexican rancher, 55 years old, light skin, a neat black goatee, a white felt cowboy hat, a burgundy western shirt with embroidered yoke, a large silver belt buckle, dark jeans, black cowboy boots, his hands empty.
chars.XIMENA_ALCANTARA: Mexican woman, 34 years old, light-brown skin, long brown hair in a low ponytail, small silver earrings, a cream western shirt, a denim jacket, jeans, tan cowboy boots, her hands empty.

locs.LOC_FERIAPARRAL: Livestock fair corrals in Parral, Chihuahua, in the afternoon: weathered wooden corral fences, wooden horse stalls under a tin roof, hay bales, a dusty ground, a chestnut stallion with a white blaze on its forehead tied at a fence, dry mountains in the distance, golden light, no readable text, no signs, no logos, no people.
